findings.claim: The generator always uses contractless members when no surrogate is supplied, so MessagePack attributes on an external formatted type are not honoured. For example, an external [MessagePackObject] type with [Key(0)] and [IgnoreMember] members will instead be serialized as a string-keyed map containing every public read-write member.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an external type annotated with [MessagePackObject], an integer [Key] on one public property, and [IgnoreMember] on another; generate its formatter without SurrogateType, round-trip it, and inspect the serialized bytes. The accepted behaviour requires the integer-keyed array and omitted ignored member, whereas this implementation produces contractless string keys and includes the ignored member.

findings.claim: Generating a formatter for a metadata-only type is an explicit opt-in exception to the existing ownership rule, rather than an accidental violation: only formatter classes annotated in the compiling assembly enter this new collector, while ordinary referenced types remain uncollected.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] records that referenced-assembly types deliberately receive no formatter or analysis from the compiling assembly. This feature preserves that default and adds the requirement's explicit [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] opt-in path, so the metadata-type exemption should not be flagged as a defect.
